parameters.name: userID
parameters.description: ID of the signed-in user. `me` is also accepted; another user's ID is refused with 403

parameters.name: tokenID
parameters.description: ID of the API token, from the list

200.description: true when the token was revoked

400.description: The token id in the path is not a positive integer

403.description: Not allowed: the request was made with an API token, or the user in the path is not the signed-in user

404.description: The signed-in user has no token with this id

description:
Deletes one of the signed-in user's tokens. It stops working at once and the revocation is in the audit log. A token that is not yours gives 404.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused)
